items.contentSnippet:
SwiftNet is a small C networking library that works at Layer 2 with libpcap (and now has a very early DPDK implementation).
I built it because I was tired of using sockets or complex libraries and wanted something simple enough for my game while still being able to go fast using compile time customizations
0.6.0 changes:
- Dynamic library build
- Changed API in buffer functions
- Simple DPDK implementation only usable right now with loopback
- Cleaner source code
- Built with maximum warnings en

items.title: Show HN: Abendrot – The free and open-source macOS app for your circadian rhythm
items.contentSnippet:
Abendrot is a handcrafted application designed for the burners of the midnight oil. I got tired of spending night after night staring into a luminous computer screen blasting blue-rich light at my eyes long after sunset. After a long deep research session with frontier models, the need for Abendrot became apparent. macOS can warm displays natively with Night Shift but it is nowhere near where it needs to be for optimal blue light reduction.
